comments.author: savid_dubs
comments.body_html: If I set everything in the recoil config to 1 I simply have no recoil. Does this mean 1 is 100% less? Your example you gave is a little poor since it’s 0.5 which could go either way

comments.author: viniHNS
comments.body_html:
Yes,

0.4 = 40% less

0.5 = 50% less.

0.6 = 60% less.

You will need to test the values to find one that suits you; the mod already comes configured the way I like it.
